_why: What is deliberately not in this repository, and the reason for each. Checked by make_release.py, which refuses to build a release containing any of it.
photographs of any person: No image or video of any person is published. The two photographs behind fig_eyecrop.pdf are of an author, taken outside any session with written consent, and stay unpublished. The session software has no image-writing path.
**/audit_key_private/, **/message_key_pr: The blinded answer keys and code mappings for the Study 2 and Study 3 human audits. Withheld so that someone else can rate the same sheets blind. The rated workbooks and every derived number are published.
data/sessions/study6_deployment/: The two Study 6 operator logs. Both operators gave written informed consent; the folder waits on one open question about institutional review, described in the top-level README. verify_paper_numbers.py checks Section 4.6 the moment it is added.
face_landmarker.task: Google's model. Downloaded by the reader rather than redistributed here; the command is in the README.
superseded result tables: Where a later run replaced an earlier one, the findings file says what changed and why. The superseded tables are in the working tree and available on request.
e2 testdata (LVIS and COCO annotation su: Third-party annotation files. results/set.jsonl records exactly which images were used, so the scoring stage runs without them.
